paragraphs: Rabbi Chiyya bar Ze’ira: [Bamidbar Rabbah 11:2](https://www.sefaria.org/Bamidbar_Rabbah.11.2). Rav Yitzchak bar Ze’ira: [Shabbat 20b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.20b.8). Rabbi Menachma bar Ze’ira: [Bereshit Rabbah 34:9](https://www.sefaria.org/Bereshit_Rabbah.34.9). Rav Shmuel bar Ze’ira: [Bamidbar Rabbah 3:8](https://www.sefaria.org/Bamidbar_Rabbah.3.8). Rav Shemayah bar Ze’ira: [Eruvin 93a](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.93a.5).[^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital Shabbat 20b fully writes Rav Yitzchak bar Ze’ira, supporting Rav for supplied ר׳. The Midrash Rabbah — TE Bamidbar Rabbah 3:8 fully writes Rabbi Shmuel bar Ze’ira, whereas Hyman fully writes Rav; that full supplied title is preserved. The five listed people are not merged.

In Bereshit Rabbah, Rav Shalom speaks in the name of Rabbi Menachma. In Bamidbar Rabbah 3:8, Rabbi Huna HaKohen speaks in the name of Rabbi Shmuel, whose title is Rav in Hyman. [Heilprin’s entry for Shmuel](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3399&lang=en) also records this chain. In Eruvin, Shemayah carries Rava’s question to Abaye.
